title: Horse Compass
description: Adds a compass to track your horse
body:
# Horse Compass

Have you ever lost your horse? Tired of searching? Craft a horse compass and track your favorite horse. 

## Usage

Craft your horse compass with the following recipe

![Compass crafting recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/XqX9Exth/images/36816e85a7ff2ab2ea8a29acc544ca3043955eaf.png)

Right click a horse with the compass to track it. A heart particle indicates that the horse is now tracked. A tracking compass glows and points to the location of the horse if you are in the same dimension.

## Trackable "Horses"

![Trackable "Horse" Spawn Eggs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3ecc26a0bc51bcb81cbc61168728fe3651a70149.png)

- Horse
- Donkey
- Mule
- Camel
- Skeleton Horse
- Zombie Horse

## Extras

Tracking a named entity automatically renames the horse compass to the named entities name.

## Extending Trackables

You can extend the trackable entites by extending the entity type tag 
`
horsecompass:trackable_by
`
 via a datapack. How to extend tags is documented on the [Minecraft Wiki#Tag](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tag_(Java_Edition)). The mod checks if an entity type has the tag and then if true saves the entity to the compass.
